title: iris aphylla subsp. fieberi
intro: Iris aphylla subsp. fieberi, commonly known as the  Fieber's iris, is a subspecies of the Iris aphylla plant. It is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Iridaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its therapeutic properties, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may help to reduce inflammation, soothe wounds, and prevent the growth of bacteria and fungi. The bioactive constituents of Fieber's iris include flavonoids, saponins, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
